title: COLD BORE
notes: A realistic online multiplayer FPS: Free-for-all, Team Deathmatch and Domination on two maps (Al-Hadra, a desert town, and Kessel Freight Yard, a container port).
Quick Play finds an online match; if there isn't one, you host one and bots fill the empty places. Bots leave as real players join. Server browser, private matches with a code, and offline vs bots.

27 real guns at their real prices (a Glock 17 is $550, an M4 $1,150, a Barrett M82 $9,500), real attachments (EOTech, ACOG, suppressors with the $200 tax stamp), melee weapons, grenades, first aid and armour. Kills pay $500 (+$250 headshot) and the money is yours for the match.
Ballistics: bullet drop, travel time, penetration through walls and bodies, armour levels IIIA / III / IV and helmets that stop what they would really stop.
Wounds where the rounds land, bleeding you have to treat (bandage, tourniquet, IFAK), limping on a leg hit, shaking aim on an arm hit. Ragdolls. Realistic gore with a slider from 0 (none) to 100.
Your bank (every dollar you earn) buys uniforms and Cerakote finishes in the Armory. Controllers (Xbox, PlayStation, Steam Deck), installable as an app.
